say:0:1310701001:0.text: The festival decorations are still here... Let's go take a look at where we made the snowmen!
say:0:1310701001:0.source_cn: 祭典装饰都还在……我们先去堆雪人那里看看！

say:2:1310703001:0.text: Has the festival not ended yet?
say:2:1310703001:0.source_cn: 咦，这里的祭典也没结束？

say:3:1310703002:0.text: It seems different from yesterday... The snowmen we made are gone, and now there are... more of them?
say:3:1310703002:0.source_cn: 但是雪人好像和昨天有点不一样。我们堆的雪人不见了，又似...

say:4:1310703003:1.text: Oh, yeah... Chippy wonders where that kid who built the snowmen with us went.
say:4:1310703003:1.source_cn: 对哦！不过那个和我们一起堆雪人的小孩子也不知道跑哪里去了。

say:5:1310703004:1.text: What should we do, Magister? Should we build another snowman?
say:5:1310703004:1.source_cn: 主人，我们怎么办，还要再堆一次雪人吗？
say:5:1310703004:1.male: What should we do, Magister? Should we build another snowman?
say:5:1310703004:1.female: What should we do, Magister? Should we build another snowman?

choice_prompt:6:1310703004.text: What should we do, Magister? Should we build another snowman?
choice_prompt:6:1310703004.source_cn: 主人，我们怎么办，还要再堆一次雪人吗？
choice_prompt:6:1310703004.male: What should we do, Magister? Should we build another snowman?
choice_prompt:6:1310703004.female: What should we do, Magister? Should we build another snowman?

say:7:1310703005:0.text: Alright, we can see what's different from yesterday...
say:7:1310703005:0.source_cn: 嗯，可以看看和昨天有什么不同……
say:7:1310703005:0.male: Alright, we can see what's different from yesterday...
say:7:1310703005:0.female: Alright, we can see what's different from yesterday...

say:10:1310703006:0.text: Hey, I finally found you! Where did you go? You promised to join me in the festivities.
say:10:1310703006:0.source_cn: 嗨——你们，总算找到你们了！你们跑到哪里去了？说好要跟...

say:11:1310703007:0.text: Come on, let's make a snowman. I want one that's all big and cute.
say:11:1310703007:0.source_cn: 快来！我们去堆雪人玩，堆一个又大又可爱的雪人！

say:12:1310703008:1.text: Your Highness, isn't the festival over...?
say:12:1310703008:1.source_cn: 公主殿下！你……你也觉得祭典没有结束吗？

say:13:1310703009:0.text: What are you talking about? The festival has just begun. How can it be over?
say:13:1310703009:0.source_cn: 咦？你在说什么啊，祭典才刚刚开始，怎么会结束呢？

say:14:1310703010:0.text: And if you ask me, with the festival being so much fun and being with you all together, I hope it never ends.
say:14:1310703010:0.source_cn: 要我说，祭典这么有趣，还有你们陪我一起玩，最好一直都不...

say:15:1310703011:0.text: Enough talking. Let's not waste any more time. I finally got the chance to leave the castle. Oh, let's head over there!
say:15:1310703011:0.source_cn: 哎呀，不说这些了。不要浪费时间，我好不容易才能出来一次...

say:0:1310704001:0.text: This time, we're going to build the biggest snowman ever!
say:0:1310704001:0.source_cn: 这次我们要堆一个最大的雪人！
say:0:1310704001:0.male: This time, we're going to build the biggest snowman ever!
say:0:1310704001:0.female: This time, we're going to build the biggest snowman ever!

say:1:1310705001:1.text: Is this your snowman? Impressive! Actually, it's the best one I've seen today!
say:1:1310705001:1.source_cn: 这是你们堆的雪人？不错，真不错！确切地说，是我今天见过...

say:2:1310705002:1.text: Here, you've earned a real petal!
say:2:1310705002:1.source_cn: 你们值得一片真正的花瓣！<key:dialog1>

say:3:1310705003:0.text: Oh! You already have a petal? Guess I gave one to you already. Ah, my memory's slipping these days...
say:3:1310705003:0.source_cn: 哎呀，你们已经有花瓣了？看来我给过你们了。唉，我真是忘...

say:0:1310721001:0.text: It's so weird! Why does everyone think the festival has just begun?!
say:0:1310721001:0.source_cn: 太诡异了！为什么所有人都觉得祭典才刚开始？

say:1:1310721002:0.text: It is strange. Let's go to the ball area and take a look...
say:1:1310721002:0.source_cn: 嗯，我们去舞会会场再看看……
say:1:1310721002:0.male: It is strange. Let's go to the ball area and take a look...
say:1:1310721002:0.female: It is strange. Let's go to the ball area and take a look...

say:0:1310722001:0.text: Nothing seems to be different here than yesterday...
say:0:1310722001:0.source_cn: 这里好像和昨天没什么区别……

say:2:1310723001:0.text: Everyone, we need to work faster. The festival has started already, and we still need to finish setting up...
say:2:1310723001:0.source_cn: 大家再加把劲儿，祭典都开始了，咱们这里还没布置完……

say:3:1310723002:0.text: We can't afford to make any mistakes at the ball!
say:3:1310723002:0.source_cn: 舞会可千万不能出差错啊！

say:4:1310723003:0.text: Excuse me, has the ball not started yet?
say:4:1310723003:0.source_cn: 请问，舞会还没有开始吗？

say:5:1310723004:0.text: Oh, yes. The masquerade ball won't begin until all the other activities are finished.
say:5:1310723004:0.source_cn: 啊，要等到其他项目都结束，化装舞会才会开始呢。

say:6:1310723005:0.text: I can tell you're anxious for it to begin. Between me and you, I can't wait either.
say:6:1310723005:0.source_cn: 哈哈，看得出来你很心急了。不过偷偷告诉你，其实我也很急呢。

say:7:1310723006:0.text: I really want to know which guest Her Highness will choose to dance with first...
say:7:1310723006:0.source_cn: 真想知道公主殿下会选择哪位客人一起跳第一支舞啊……

say:2:1310724001:0.text: The whole place hasn't been set up yet.
say:2:1310724001:0.source_cn: 会场果然也成了还没有布置完毕的样子。

say:3:1310724002:0.text: It's similar to the hot springs inn.
say:3:1310724002:0.source_cn: 和温泉旅馆的情况很像呢……

say:4:1310724003:1.text: Magister, the festival did end, didn't it?
say:4:1310724003:1.source_cn: 呃……主人，祭典确实结束了……对吧？
say:4:1310724003:1.male: Magister, the festival did end, didn't it?
say:4:1310724003:1.female: Magister, the festival did end, didn't it?

choice_prompt:5:1310724003.text: Magister, the festival did end, didn't it?
choice_prompt:5:1310724003.source_cn: 呃……主人，祭典确实结束了……对吧？
choice_prompt:5:1310724003.male: Magister, the festival did end, didn't it?
choice_prompt:5:1310724003.female: Magister, the festival did end, didn't it?

say:6:1310724004:1.text: They were so serious that Chippy thought the festival really didn't end yet.
say:6:1310724004:1.source_cn: 唉，他们所有人都是这幅一本正经的样子，满满都开始怀疑自...
say:6:1310724004:1.male: They were so serious that Chippy thought the festival really didn't end yet.
say:6:1310724004:1.female: They were so serious that Chippy thought the festival really didn't end yet.

choice:5:1:2.text: I was a part of the closing ceremony.
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 我亲自参与了闭幕仪式！
choice:5:1:2.male: I was a part of the closing ceremony.
choice:5:1:2.female: I was a part of the closing ceremony.

say:0:1310725001:0.text: The whole thing reeks of weirdness...
say:0:1310725001:0.source_cn: 整件事散发着一股诡异的味道……

say:1:1310725002:0.text: Let's find a quiet place and talk about this.
say:1:1310725002:0.source_cn: 我们得找个地方好好讨论一下。
say:1:1310725002:0.male: Let's find a quiet place and talk about this.
say:1:1310725002:0.female: Let's find a quiet place and talk about this.

say:2:1310726001:1.text: This is beyond bizarre. I need to sort out my thoughts...
say:2:1310726001:1.source_cn: 太奇怪了，太奇怪了！我必须要好好思考，理清思路……

say:3:1310726002:1.text: Okay, the biggest problem is that everyone, except for us, thinks the festival isn't over. Wait, no... they don't even realize there was a festival yesterday.
say:3:1310726002:1.source_cn: 最大的问题是——除了我们，所有人都觉得祭典还没有结束…...

say:4:1310726003:1.text: Yeah, in their minds, the festival has just begun. They're doing and saying the same things as yesterday!
say:4:1310726003:1.source_cn: 对呀，在他们看来，这就是第一次祭典。他们就像是又回到了...

choice_prompt:5:1310726003.text: Yeah, in their minds, the festival has just begun. They're doing and saying the same things as yesterday!
choice_prompt:5:1310726003.source_cn: 对呀，在他们看来，这就是第一次祭典。他们就像是又回到了庆典刚开始一样，做同样的事，说同样的话！

say:6:1310726004:0.text: Yes, that's it! They're just repeating what they did during the festival...
say:6:1310726004:0.source_cn: 对对对，就是这样！他们就像陷入祭典那段时间里一样，不停...
say:6:1310726004:0.male: Yes, that's it! They're just repeating what they did during the festival...
say:6:1310726004:0.female: Yes, that's it! They're just repeating what they did during the festival...

say:7:1310726005:0.text: But when something changed, those people reacted differently. They didn't repeat everything exactly the same.
say:7:1310726005:0.source_cn: 可是，如果发生了不同情况，那些人也会有不同反应，并不是...
say:7:1310726005:0.male: But when something changed, those people reacted differently. They didn't repeat everything exactly the same.
say:7:1310726005:0.female: But when something changed, those people reacted differently. They didn't repeat everything exactly the same.

say:8:1310726006:0.text: Yes, those people are still free to react differently to different situations. Also, the petals they gave to us before did not reappear...
say:8:1310726006:0.source_cn: 的确，那些人依旧有自己的意识，对不同情况也会有不同反应...
say:8:1310726006:0.male: Yes, those people are still free to react differently to different situations. Also, the petals they gave to us before did not reappear...
say:8:1310726006:0.female: Yes, those people are still free to react differently to different situations. Also, the petals they gave to us before did not reappear...

say:9:1310726007:0.text: It's so strange that the objects aren't duplicated, but people are repeating all the things they've done.
say:9:1310726007:0.source_cn: 物品不会被复制，但人却会重复他们做过的事情，太奇怪了！
say:9:1310726007:0.male: It's so strange that the objects aren't duplicated, but people are repeating all the things they've done.
say:9:1310726007:0.female: It's so strange that the objects aren't duplicated, but people are repeating all the things they've done.

say:10:1310726008:0.source_cn: 报告主人，满满发现今天的“祭典”和上次相比，少了一些人！
say:10:1310726008:0.male: Chippy has discovered that there are fewer people at today's festival than last time!
say:10:1310726008:0.female: Chippy has discovered that there are fewer people at today's festival than last time!

choice_prompt:11:1310726008.source_cn: 报告主人，满满发现今天的“祭典”和上次相比，少了一些人！
choice_prompt:11:1310726008.male: Chippy has discovered that there are fewer people at today's festival than last time!
choice_prompt:11:1310726008.female: Chippy has discovered that there are fewer people at today's festival than last time!

say:12:1310726009:0.text: Oh, yes! The Graveborn in the Ghostly Getaway and the ball are gone, and even Mister Faramor, who was chasing them, is nowhere to be seen...
say:12:1310726009:0.source_cn: 咦，真的！鬼影密室和舞会里捣乱的亡灵不见了，连一直追着...
say:12:1310726009:0.male: Oh, yes! The Graveborn in the Ghostly Getaway and the ball are gone, and even Mister Faramor, who was chasing them, is nowhere to be seen...
say:12:1310726009:0.female: Oh, yes! The Graveborn in the Ghostly Getaway and the ball are gone, and even Mister Faramor, who was chasing them, is nowhere to be seen...

say:13:1310726010:0.text: Yeah, that little kid we built the snowmen with ran off somewhere, and the town also seemed to be less crowded than before.
say:13:1310726010:0.source_cn: 对，那个和我们一起堆雪人的小孩子不知道跑哪去了。镇子里...

say:13:1310726010:0.female: Yeah, that little kid we built the snowmen with ran off somewhere, and the town also seemed to be less crowded than before.

say:14:1310726011:0.text: This is really scary... Everyone is stuck in a time loop, and some people have disappeared...
say:14:1310726011:0.source_cn: 呀，真让人毛骨悚然……大家都浑浑噩噩地陷入了时间循环，...

say:15:1310726012:0.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think this all has to do with those strange Graveborn?
say:15:1310726012:0.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think this all has to do with those strange Graveborn?
say:15:1310726012:0.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think this all has to do with those strange Graveborn?

say:16:1310726013:1.text: Everything related to the Graveborn disappeared from the festival. It's almost as if it's on purpose. There's also that rumor about the undead serving the Hypogeans.
say:16:1310726013:1.source_cn: 祭典里和亡灵相关的一切都消失了，就像是故意的一样！这里...
say:16:1310726013:1.male: Everything related to the Graveborn disappeared from the festival. It's almost as if it's on purpose. There's also that rumor about the undead serving the Hypogeans.
say:16:1310726013:1.female: Everything related to the Graveborn disappeared from the festival. It's almost as if it's on purpose. There's also that rumor about the undead serving the Hypogeans.

say:17:1310726014:1.source_cn: 满满记得点火仪式的时候，公主殿下说过山脉背面的古战场里...

say:19:1310726015:1.text: Yes, Chippy was thinking the same thing! They tried to ruin the festival during the Ghostly Getaway and also the ball.

say:20:1310726016:1.female: But we can't jump to any conclusions just yet. There's no conclusive evidence.

say:0:1310726101:0.source_cn: 走吧，希望我们能在点火仪式会场找到新的线索。

say:0:1310727101:0.source_cn: 唔，这里没有下去的路，我们去那边找找看。

say:2:1310728001:0.text: How do we cross the mountain? Do we have to climb down or something?

say:3:1310728002:0.source_cn: 刚才你也看到了，山崖下的矿洞能通向古战场……我们应该可...

say:6:1310728005:0.source_cn: 不许说不吉利的话！我们先去附近找人问问，说不定有人知道...
